summary: Post-market 2026-11-03: the global risk score closed at 63.02, still high_risk and 3.43 points below Monday's 66.45, while the regime flipped to indeterminate for the first time in the 67-session record because no rule in the ladder fires: VIX 21.15 sits below the 28 risk-off gate, breadth at 0.3742 clears its 0.35 gate, the curve at 0.38 is neither inverted nor steep, cross-asset confirmation at 0.50 misses the 0.55 late-cycle gate and momentum at -1.994 is negative. Almost none of the decline is de-risking: 3.75 points come from cross-asset confirmation falling from 6 of 8 legs to 4 as SPY turned up 0.3111 percent and bitcoin 1.3536 percent, and 1.58 points from the new-low count collapsing from 61 of 157 names to 12. Against that, the overnight reverse repo drained from 5.087 to 0.427 billion dollars, lifting the liquidity dimension to 77.27, now the heaviest of the six, while the VIX vintage advanced from 19.42 to 21.15. The tape itself was a rotation, not a recovery: 19 of 22 rows rose, averaging 1.4771 percent, led by data centres at 5.4407 and the 4 tracked US semis at 2.8997, with the S&P 500 up 0.37 percent, the Nasdaq up 0.83 percent, the Dow down 0.38 percent, Tesla down 1.3174 percent and the EV supply chain down 1.1177 percent.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Liquidity and credit at 77.27 is the heaviest of the six dimensions and one of two with a rising trend: high-yield OAS at 3.43 scores 87.63 and investment grade at 0.94 scores 77.27, so 7.0104 points of the total sit in credit spreads that did not tighten during the rebound. The overnight reverse repo at 0.427 billion dollars scores 91.49 through the neutral deviation mapping: the facility is effectively drained, so the dimension reads high by construction, whatever the tape does.

Cross-asset confirmation stands at 0.50, 4 of 8 scoring legs, for 7.5 points. 3 of those 4 are level or cumulative conditions that were already firing: the dollar index at 121.6656 above 105, the real rate at 2.60 above 1.50 and small caps 4.6677 points behind on a 63-session basis. Only copper, down 2.1625 percent, is a fresh same-day signal, so with no fresh signal the floor is 3 of 8 legs, worth 5.625 points.

Volatility scored 45.87 and contributed 5.86 points through the VIX leg alone: 21.15 is the 2026-11-02 close, one session behind this run, yet it sits 10.01 points above realized volatility of 11.1424. That is the widest implied-versus-realized gap in the model, with implied vol pricing stress that realized moves have not delivered, and it makes volatility the dimension most exposed to a restatement when the 2026-11-03 print lands.

Breadth at 0.3742, 58 of 155 constituents above their 200-day average, contributes 4.7223 points and leads the repair in the structure: the new-low ratio collapsed to 0.0764 (12 of 157) while the new-high ratio at 0.0064 is 1 name. No leadership is being built, and semis relative strength is still 10.3858 points behind on a 63-session basis.

Macro at 72.92 is unchanged on the day and still leans on a real 10-year rate of 2.60 at the 97.43 percentile, a nominal 10-year of 4.94 and a curve of 0.38 for a 4.8715-point contribution. All three are 2026-10-30 prints, two sessions behind, so the dimension describes last week's rates rather than tonight's.

supporting_signals.claim: Credit has not confirmed the equity rebound: high-yield OAS at 3.43 against 3.44 the prior session and investment grade flat at 0.94, with the liquidity dimension rising from 72.12 to 77.27. The 7.0104-point credit contribution and the 4.8715-point real-rate contribution both kept running today.
The liquidity buffer is spent: the overnight reverse repo at 0.427 billion dollars reads 91.49 on the risk scale while the balance sheet still contracts, from 6753604 to 6745635 million dollars.

The structure is narrow rather than healthy: 1 name of 157 made a new high and 62.6 percent of constituents sit below their 200-day average, while the index itself is 3.4234 percent above its own 200-day average, so the average is carried by a handful of heavyweights.

contradicting_signals.claim: The bounce was broad inside the theme layer: 19 of 22 rows rose and averaged 1.4771 percent, led by data centres at 5.4407, AI infrastructure at 3.6104 and semiconductors at 2.5019, with only 3 rows down and the worst, autos, down 1.3174 percent.
The risk-off gate is no longer breached: breadth rose from 0.3355 to 0.3742 and the new-low ratio fell from 0.3885 to 0.0764, the largest single improvement in today's dataset.

Crypto risk appetite turned: bitcoin rose 1.3536 percent to 77787 and ether 1.77587 percent, which is what switched off one of the two lost confirmation legs, while realized volatility of 11.1424, scored at 14.57, remains the calmest of the six dimensions.

what_changed_today: The score fell 3.43 points to 63.02 from 66.45. Decomposition: cross-asset 3.75 points lower, equity structure 1.58 lower, liquidity and credit 1.03 higher, volatility 0.71 higher, macro 0.24 higher and trend 0.08 lower.

Cross-asset confirmation slid from 6 of 8 legs to 4, cutting its contribution from 11.25 to 7.5 points: SPY closed up 0.3111 percent and bitcoin up 1.3536 percent, switching off both downside legs while the dollar, real-rate and small-cap legs stayed on.

Breadth repaired: constituents above the 200-day average went from 52 of 155 to 58, new lows fell from 61 of 157 to 12 and new highs stayed at 1. That alone moved the equity structure dimension from 74.80 to 66.89.
The overnight reverse repo fell from 5.087 to 0.427 billion dollars on the 2026-11-03 print, lifting the liquidity dimension from 72.12 to 77.27 and making it the heaviest dimension in the model.

The VIX vintage advanced to 21.15 from 19.42, taking volatility from 41.14 to 45.87. Rates did not advance: the 10-year at 4.94, the 2-year at 4.56 and the real rate at 2.60 are still 2026-10-30 prints, two sessions behind.

The regime flipped from risk_off to indeterminate, the first such reading in the 67-session record: breadth clears the 0.35 gate by 0.0242 and no benign branch fires, so the model declines to characterise the tape.

The A-share block in this layer is the 2026-11-02 settled session, not today's: 9 of 11 names rose for a mean of 1.4932 percent. The 2026-11-03 A-share close is absent from the feed, so no China move is quoted for 11-03 here.
watch_next: AMD was scheduled to report after today's close against a 1.95 consensus from the FMP calendar, having risen 3.6544 percent in the session; tomorrow's open prices the result, and with the stock 13.6294 percent lower over the past week part of a beat is already paid for.

Today's JOLTS opened the week's labour data: openings at 7.52 million, up 333 thousand from August and above a 7.15 million consensus, with the 2026-11-06 Employment Situation the next high-importance event.
The 2026-11-10 CPI follows: with the curve at 0.38 and breakevens at 2.29 and 2.19, the inflation channel is the one macro channel that has not repriced.
Breadth has only 0.0242 of cushion above the 0.35 risk-off gate; one weak session is enough to put the regime back to risk_off with the score already 3.02 points above the 60 high_risk line.

Two vintage gaps to watch: the 2026-11-03 VIX print and the 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03 rate prints are not in this layer, so volatility and macro will restate without any new price move when they land.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the de-rating ends with breadth repair, not with a new low
points: The compute chain led the rebound, which is exactly where the 2026-11-02 damage sat: the 4 tracked semis averaged 2.8997 percent, with Nvidia 2.2914, Broadcom 3.0723, AMD 3.6544 and Micron 2.5804, and data centres at 5.4407.

New lows fell from 61 of 157 to 12 in one session and breadth rose to 0.3742, clearing the 0.35 gate; a second session in the same direction retires the risk-off condition without needing a VIX collapse.
Credit is calm: high-yield OAS at 3.43 and investment grade at 0.94, one 0.01 move and one flat print versus the prior session, so the equity drawdown has not been confirmed by credit.
Realized volatility of 11.1424 and a 52-week drawdown of 3.164 percent say the 2026-11-02 selloff was orderly, and the index is still 3.4234 percent above its own 200-day average.

base_case.title: Base case: high_risk with no regime, a 60 to 66 band, breadth the only lever
points: 63.02 sits 3.02 points above the 60 high_risk line with the cross-asset floor at 3 of 8 legs, worth 5.625 points, so the downside room is mechanical rather than thematic.
The 3.43-point decline came from two legs switching off and one ratio collapsing, while none of the four chronic legs moved, so it can be retraced inside a single risk-off session.
Liquidity at 77.27 and volatility at 45.87 are both rising, so any retracement starts from a higher base than the 54.70 print of 2026-10-28.
The next genuine repricing comes from data: AMD's result first, then the 2026-11-06 Employment Situation and the 2026-11-10 CPI behind it.

bear_case.title: Bear case: volatility and credit catch up with the tape
points: VIX at 21.15 against realized 11.1424 is a 10.01-point gap; if realized volatility closes half of it, the volatility dimension at 45.87 on a 15.0 weight has a long way to run and takes the score with it.
A fifth cross-asset leg is one threshold away: high-yield OAS at 3.43 needs only 4.0, which lifts confirmation to 0.625 and the dimension to 62.5 for 1.875 extra points.
The reverse repo buffer is drained at 0.427 billion dollars while the balance sheet still contracts, so the liquidity dimension at 77.27 has no offset if reserves turn tight.
New highs at 1 of 157 leave the tape without leadership; if breadth rolls back under 0.35 the regime returns to risk_off with the score already above 60.
